thread.title: Buffett: Berkshire bought 'more Apple than anything else' over last year

author: Barbara Kollmeyer
title: Buffett: Berkshire bought 'more Apple than anything else' over last year
text: Warren Buffett on Monday underlined Berkshire Hathaway Inc.'s BRK.A, +0.87% BRK.B, +1.01% appetite for Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.74% shares over the past year. "If you look at our holdings, you would assume that we like them in the order in which they rank by dollar value of holdings, but if you look at them in terms of recent purchases over the last year we've bought more Apple than anything else," he told CNBC in an interview . Buffett's annual investor letter on Saturday showed that Apple was Berkshire's second-largest holding with a market value of $28.2 billion, behind Wells Fargo WFC, +0.61% at $29.3 billion and ahead of Bank of America BAC, +1.07% at $20.7 billion.
